name: dogfood-security-sbom-scanning-app
description: Dogfood app v1.37-4 — a Trivy + Gitleaks style Software Bill Of Materials + secrets scanning service (CycloneDX + SPDX emission + OSV/NVD advisory lookup + SPDX license policy + TruffleHog / Gitleaks signatures + rotation SLA tracking) that drives an SBOM + secrets surface backed by @kiwa-lab/security v0.1 sbom + secrets-scan semantics, runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (KIWA_ADVISORY_FEED_URL + KIWA_TRIVY_ENDPOINT + KIWA_GITLEAKS_ENDPOINT scanner endpoints) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory feed + regex scan) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-lab/core -F @kiwa-lab/security -F @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
